llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文研究铝基复合材料的选择性激光熔化，与生物医学植入物设计无关。
llm.why_not_core: No porous structure, no stress shielding analysis, no fatigue testing, no biomedical context, no surface roughness for osseointegration.

summary_zh.motivation: 研究起始碳化硅颗粒尺寸对选区激光熔化铝基复合材料性能的影响
summary_zh.method: 采用不同粒径SiC颗粒制备Al4SiC4+SiC混合增强铝基复合材料
summary_zh.result: 细颗粒SiC促进Al4SiC4原位生成，提高硬度和耐磨性
summary_zh.validation: 通过XRD、SEM、硬度测试和摩擦磨损实验验证

summary_en.motivation: Investigate the influence of starting SiC particle size on the microstructure and mechanical properties of Al matrix composites fabricated by selective laser melting.
summary_en.method: Al4SiC4+SiC hybrid reinforced Al matrix composites were produced via SLM using different SiC particle sizes.
summary_en.result: Fine SiC particles promoted in-situ formation of Al4SiC4, resulting in improved hardness and wear resistance.
summary_en.validation: Validation via XRD, SEM, hardness testing, and dry sliding wear tests.
